daily.topThemeTitle: Teachers, Not Tech Leaders, Are Setting AI's Classroom Rules
daily.topThemeBody: EdSurge reports 48% of educators say teachers and administrators — not IT departments — hold primary responsibility for AI implementation, per Turnitin's Q2 report, as NCTE circulates a working ELA AI framework for grades 6-12.

heroWeek.themeTitle: Washington Weighs In, Leaves Room for Nuance
heroWeek.themeBody: The Department of Education's new edtech guidance sets a purposeful, outcomes-driven bar but defers rulemaking to states, while EdTech Digest finds the screen-time debate growing more nuanced rather than settling on blanket bans.
